title: Senior Game Client Developer
text:
Demo Co. Larch is a startup building travel apps. We are looking for a senior-level Game Client Developer to join our mobile team. Work is two office days a week in Brightwater Bay.

Our stack: csharp, dart. You will improve app performance and stability, build offline-first features and ship features end to end.

Four-day weeks in summer. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
